title: Live forensic finding dispositions
root_cause: Archive findings required direct falsification against the live source before entering the repair denominator.
source_requirement: Reproduce or falsify PX-AUD-001 through PX-AUD-013 on the current tree with bounded probes.
implementation_steps: Run focused read-only or disposable falsification.
Record current disposition, measured result, owner, and conclusion.
negative_cases: Do not copy archive claims without live evidence.
Do not run broad test stages.
evidence_required: One source-bound disposition for every mandatory forensic finding.
rollback: Remove only invalid audit projections; preserve source and archive evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 mandatory findings are accounted for.
Any PRESENT_LIVE finding maps to repair cards.
